user_story: As a guest, I want to cancel my booking so that I can free up the reservation.

positive.title: Successfully cancel an existing booking
steps: Log in as a guest user.
Select an existing booking from the list.
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully canceled, and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a booking with no internet connection
steps: Log in as a guest user on a device.
Select an existing booking from the list.
negative.expected_result: A failure notification is displayed indicating that an internet connection is required to process the booking cancellation.

edge.title: Cancel a booking that has already been checked-in
steps: Log in as a guest user.
Select a booking that has already been checked-in.
Attempt to click the 'Cancel Booking' button.
edge.expected_result: A notification is displayed indicating that the booking cannot be canceled as it has already been checked-in.
